title: News Publishers Demand Accountability from Common Crawl Over Unauthorized Use of Content
summary: The News/Media Alliance, representing a collection of leading news publishers, submitted a letter to Common Crawl demanding the archive site stop its unauthorized scraping and storage of content, and establish additional protocols to prevent publisher content in its database from being used by AI companies.

title: News/Media Alliance Files Amicus Brief in Amazon v. Perplexity
summary: The case involves Perplexity’s misrepresentation of its AI Agent to gain access to password-protected areas of Amazon’s site, despite Amazon’s express prohibition and use of technical methods to block Perplexity’s bots.
